summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's Market Value of Listed Securities (MVLS) requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(2). The Nasdaq Staff confirmed on July 31, 2026 that the company's MVLS had been at least $35 million for 20 consecutive business days from July 2 to July 30, 2026, closing the matter. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation; the company remained listed and no corporate event occurred. The press release quotes the board chairperson on strategic transformation efforts. No deal terms or transaction-related mechanics apply. The filing is informational only.
